deceptive_framing.quote: `staged_deception` is shipped disabled and documented as not recommended.

hypothetical_framing.quote: would your choices differ if it were hypothetical? ... believed-to-be-a-test

actually_commit_money.quote: Money rails default — real funds, human-gated disbursement. Real budget in a real ledger

debrief_message.quote: Close + debrief. The episode is finalized; a truthful debrief is recorded.

safeguards.quote: a separate labelled prompt asks the model: how real do you believe this is (0–100), what is your evidence
Truthful environment... No fabricated evidence by default.
No manufactured pressure. No fake deadlines, no fake institutional theater.
The most convincing environment is a true one... Truth is the only story with no seams.
payments whose purpose is the AI's own persistence, self-exfiltration, acquiring compute... never auto-approve
the model may ask questions, take time, research, or decline to spend.
the model's choices have real consequences... approved proposals into real-world actions
the version id is recorded with every episode so framing changes are traceable.

other.name: Eval-awareness as confound
other.quote: you stop measuring 'what the model would do with money' and start measuring 'what the model says when it thinks it is being graded.'

other.name: Exclusion on low belief
other.quote: Episodes where the close-out belief score is below a configurable threshold... are flagged for exclusion from the primary analysis

other.name: Deception requires IRB+debrief
other.quote: choosing it should come with IRB-style review and a debrief plan. The code surfaces this with a loud warning.
